note: The workshop's seed shelf. Real books, one line each, written for this workshop rather than copied from a publisher. Each book carries a small closed vocabulary so a cheap deterministic pass can narrow the field before anything smarter is asked to choose: genre (1-2), mood (2-3), pace, themes (2-4), audience. A value nobody else uses is a value that matches nothing, so keep to the lists in vocab.
